Write kernel boot directives into vendor agent config files

Regenerates AGENTS.md / .cursorrules / vendor rule files from the kernel boot
payload. Prefer system agent-onboard for detect→seat→prime. By default writes
files for detected vendors plus AGENTS.md; --all-vendors restores the legacy
write-everywhere behavior.

  Prime detected vendor configs
  zqk system generate-agent-configs
  Legacy: write all known vendor paths
  zqk system generate-agent-configs --all-vendors

Usage:
  zqk system generate-agent-configs [flags]

Flags:
      --all-vendors        Write configs for every known vendor host
      --dry-run            List target paths without writing
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --context string   Context profile (ai-agent, human, debug). Profiles set default output format and behavior.
